gizmo.title: Nyimbo zolembedwa
gizmo.description: Imawonetsa ndi kuimba nyimbo zolembedwa, ma tabu a gitala, ndi zolemba za nyimbo kudzera mu alphaTex kapena MusicXML.

configure.title: Zolemba za AlphaTex
configure.description: Zolemba za alphaTex za nyimbo zolembedwa. Sinthani mwachindunji kuti mulembe; zimasungidwa mu template kuti mipata isungidwe.

configure.title: Fayilo ya nyimbo
configure.description: Kwezani kapena lumikizani ku fayilo ya MusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl) kapena Guitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp). Imaposa alphaTex ya mkati ikaikidwa.

advanced.title: Kuimba mawu
advanced.description: Yatsidwa mwachisawawa - mverani nyimbo zolembedwa zikuimbidwa ndi chopangira mawu chomangidwa mkati. Zimitsani kuti mungowonera (popanda mawu).

advanced.title: Onetsani zosankha zowonetsera
advanced.description: Onetsani mabatani okulitsa, otambasula, ndi a kapangidwe pa mzere wa choseweretsa.

advanced.title: Onetsani mabatani otumiza kunja
advanced.description: Onetsani mabatani otsitsa MIDI ndi osindikiza/PDF pa mzere wa choseweretsa.
